title: Post-Compaction Recovery
desc: Recovery checklist after compaction or session reset; re-load recent state, logs, and active drafting context.
steps: Re-read MEMORY.md and recent git commits.
Check active draft folders and open deadlines.
Verify current Chrome/CDP state if browser work is involved.
Re-load the specific task checklist before continuing.
Use this as the first read after a compacted or resumed session.
